description.p: EzyView is a self-hosted trading terminal with charts, indicators, drawing tools, a Pine Script editor, paper trading, a trading journal, market research panels and optional MetaTrader 5 connectivity.
All charting features are available without a subscription. Provider API keys and broker credentials are stored in the operating system keyring.
Trading safety fixes for paper and MetaTrader 5 closes and stops.
Policy-compliant Debian package with licence and documentation files.
